subject: POL-1418: how many times the retention period changed
body:
Nora Lindqvist (QA) writing with a quick request. How many
times did the retention period change across the revisions
of the Access Control Standard?

The first revision setting the value is not a change; count
only later revisions where the value differs from the
previous one.

Regards, Nora Lindqvist -- QA
